title: ocgo headless run findings
description: Findings produced by a scope-enforced Codex run. Consumed by scripts/check-findings.py and, above the confidence threshold, queued for independent validation.

summary.description: One paragraph on what the run did and did not establish.

title.description: One line naming the defect and its consequence.

asset.description: The in-scope host the finding applies to.

class.description: The bug class, for example broken_access_control or information_disclosure.

evidence.description: Raw requests and responses, quoted, that show the behaviour.

repro_steps.description: Ordered steps another person can follow.

impact.description: What an attacker gains, in the programme's terms.

caveats.description: What was not tested, or what would falsify this.
